title: introduce-kinetic-backpressure-holdoff-controller
author: Priya Nambiar
release_notes: Adds an adaptive holdoff controller that smooths regional backpressure signals and reduces oscillatory failover; no behavioral changes to public API. Recommended rollout to Canary before global rollout.
description:
Summary: Implement a telemetry-backed 'Kinetic Backpressure Holdoff Controller' to smooth transient overload signals from regional health probes and avoid aggressive failovers. Motivation: During several incidents we observed oscillatory regional failovers driven by short-lived probe bursts and abrupt circuit flips. This PR introduces a lightweight signal normalizer + warmup window that dynamically prolongs holdoff when a region is exhibiting high variance, reducing wasteful failovers and improving overall SLO stability.

What this changes (single-string description): The change introduces a new controller in runtime/eviction that consumes existing region health metrics (p50/p95 latency, error-rate derivative) and computes a kinetic score. The holdoff duration for regional failover/circuit-open transitions is adjusted by a smoothing factor proportional to recent signal kinetic energy so that noisy spikes lead to gentle, time-decayed extensions rather than immediate eviction. The controller is policy-driven: default policy is conservative for production but can be tuned per-customer in Dedicated/Private deployments.

Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-4321) - [x] unit tests for smoothing math and boundary cases - [x] integration test for simulated burst -> no oscillatory failover - [x] telemetry/metrics added for kinetic_score, holdoff_extension_ms - [x] e2e canary run (small fleet) completed

Commits summary: - feat(holdoff): add kinetic score calculator and policy bindings (priya/kinetic-score) - feat(holdoff): integrate kinetic controller into region state machine and expose metrics (priya/holdoff-integration) - test: add unit/integration tests and a load simulation harness (priya/tests)

Files changed (high-level): - runtime/eviction/kinetic_controller.go (new) - runtime/eviction/holdoff_policy.go (modified) - runtime/eviction/holdoff_policy_test.go (new) - observability/metrics/registry.go (modified to register kinetic_score, holdoff_extension_ms) - integration/simulators/regional_burst_sim.go (new test harness) - docs/operational/holdoff-controller.md (new) - scripts/deploy/canary.yaml (updated canary rollout config)

Code snippets (small illustrative): - kinetic score core: "func kineticEnergy(samples []float64) float64 { /* compute variance-weighted derivative */ }" - policy usage: "holdoff = baseHoldoff + policy.SmoothingFactor*kineticEnergy(history)"

Testing and CI: - CI matrix: unit (go test ./...), linters (golangci-lint), integration (small simulation) - Initial CI run: one flaky integration test (integration/simulators/regional_burst_sim.go) failed on first run due to timing race; reran integration job, passed. Final CI state: pass.

Review conversation (high level): - Evan Lu (reviewer): "Nice approach, I like the kinetic metaphor. Two questions: 1) how do we guarantee this won't indefinitely prolong holdoff on a partially recovered region? 2) can we expose the saturation cap for holdoff extension?" - Priya (author): "Answered: controller decays kinetic energy with exponential half-life (configurable); added a max_extension_ms cap and a telemetry alert if cap is hit. See holdoff_policy.go changes lines ~120-160." - Sofia Martinez: "Please add an integration test that simulates repeated small bursts — verify no cumulative drift." - Priya: "Added repeated-burst scenario in regional_burst_sim.go; included assertions on no cumulative growth beyond cap." - Oliver Grant: "Suggest adding an opt-out flag for dedicated/private installs for early adopters; otherwise looks good." - Priya: "Added install-time flag and updated docs/operational/holdoff-controller.md with instructions." - Evan Lu: "Approval: LGTM after addressing comments." 

Operational notes: - Metrics added: telemetry/kinetic_score (histogram), telemetry/holdoff_extension_ms (gauge), telemetry/holdoff_cap_hit (counter). - Dashboard: new panel added under runtime > regional-failover to visualize kinetic_score vs regional_ejects. - Canary guidance: enable controller in canary region for 48h, monitor holdoff_cap_hit and regional_ejects. If cap_hit rate > 1% over 24h, lower smoothing_factor by 25%.

Rollout & rollback: - Rollout method: gradual canary in canary.yaml -> 10% -> 50% -> global. - Rollback path: flip feature flag runtime.features.kinetic_holdoff=false and redeploy controllers.

Merge outcome: squashed merge into main on 2026-02-14 after CI passed and approvals. Changelog entry created under docs/operational/CHANGELOG.md.

Notes on uniqueness/compatibility: This implementation focuses on smoothing high-frequency variance (kinetic energy) of telemetry signals rather than absolute thresholds; it complements existing SLO enforcement and circuit logic by avoiding oscillations under noisy probes. No API breaking changes; policy knobs are additive and disabled by default for Dedicated/Private until customer opt-in.
